dropped.claim: USA TODAY CO. operates a declining legacy media business with revenue contracting from $2.9B to $2.3B over three years at -7.9% CAGR, but has achieved a profitability inflection with positive net income of $1.7M in 2025 after three consecutive loss years and generates consistent operating cash flow of $114.4M that substantially exceeds reported earnings, enabling ongoing deleveraging from $1.2B to $954.2M in long-term debt.
